tickets.subject: Read access to terminal KPI schema in Snowflake
tickets.body: Hi team, please grant read-only access to the PORT_OPS_DW.TERMINAL_KPI schema in Snowflake for our new analyst Rahul Menon (rahul.menon@portgroup-example.ae). He needs it for the weekly terminal productivity report. His manager Fatima Al Mansoori has approved. Thanks.

tickets.subject: Country-wise throughput dashboard shows wrong TEU figures
tickets.body: The Country-wise Container Throughput dashboard shows TEU volumes for Terminal 2 about 18% lower than the terminal operating system for October. The CEO office uses these figures in tomorrow morning's performance review. Please investigate urgently and call me on +971 55 987 6543.

tickets.subject: Nightly ETL job VESSEL_CALLS_LOAD failed
tickets.body: The nightly ETL pipeline VESSEL_CALLS_LOAD failed at 02:15 with a Snowflake warehouse timeout. As a result the berth utilisation and vessel turnaround reports still show yesterday's data. Port operations review these reports at 09:00. Please restart and check the root cause.

tickets.subject: Duplicate container records after source migration
tickets.body: Since the import manifest source system was migrated last weekend, we see duplicate container records in IMPORT_MANIFEST (around 3,200 duplicates). The customs reconciliation report no longer matches the terminal system. Can the data quality team check the deduplication rules?

tickets.subject: Q3 export volumes by country for board pack
tickets.body: Could you prepare a one-off extract of monthly export container volumes by destination country for Q3, split by terminal? It is needed for the board pack at the end of next week. Contact me at omar.haddad@portgroup-example.ae if anything is unclear.
